question: In its written answer of 2 February 2026 to question P-004836/20251 on the Commission’s call on Malta to comply with EU rules on the recognition and enforcement of judgments in the area of gambling, the Commission stated that it was examining the arguments put forward by Malta and would then decide on the appropriate follow-up once that analysis was completed. 1.
What is the actual deadline for the examination of the arguments put forward by Malta?
On what specific date can the analysis be expected to be completed and follow-up measures to be decided upon?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (27.3.2026)

The Commission must carry out its assessment in full compliance with EU law and on the basis of all relevant legal and factual elements. Given the complexity of the file and the involvement of multiple actors in the analysis, it is not possible at this stage to indicate a concrete deadline for the completion of the examination in this matter or possible follow-up measures. The Commission will decide on the appropriate follow-up once its examination has been completed.
